sediment_units: m;GlobSedv3PANGAEA982339 archive MD5verified;internal netCDF history contains an inherited v2label
primary_spatial_operator: exact spherical-area intersection of piecewise-constant native node Voronoi cells, including dateline half cells and clipped polar bounds; no interpolation of heat fields
sensitivity_operator: nearest sediment sample on age nodes with full age-node cell area;not extra geophysical evidence
missing: unknown age or sediment is not zero heat; report known overlap and unknown area separately

Hasterok2013_diagnostic.physical_clip: negative fit tail below zero is clipped and clipping magnitude reported
Hasterok2013_diagnostic.minimum_age: use actual positive dataset ages, no arbitrary age floor;report<1Ma separately
Hasterok2013_diagnostic.scope: present-day background diagnostic;not modern additional B or exact reproduction of2013MonteCarlo

basin_assignment: nearest existing native wet-cell centre on unit sphere;retain source grid area rather than forcing match to ocean model wet areas;record assignment distances

geometry_test.global_constraint: F<=0.04*A_eligible_flank/1e12 with no overlap ofcollectionareas;condition on treating age/sedimentmask as exhaustive
geometry_test.regional_constraint: F*w_flank_r<=0.04*A_eligible_flank_r/1e12;diagnostic of retained basin weights, not new source inversion
geometry_test.missing_sediment_sensitivity: all unknown sediment with1<=age<75 qualifies only as most-permissive coverage bound; not imputed measured classification
geometry_test.power_tests: originalS2_P3 and alternative8/10TW caps, with new global geometryconstraint;no changes toclimate/observation supports or temperature/loss scans

capacity_test: report required connected rock area as fraction of independent eligible collection area usingprevious complete histories;do not infer rocktemperaturefromoutletfluidtemperature
temporal_test: audit same-footprint integrated repeat power, baseline, duration and coverage in retained records;no unknown-as-zero or globaltrendfromstaticgeology
